name: pocketstation
description: Native desktop audio Sessions for Node.js

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:typescript
scripts.build:native: node tools/clean-native-output.mjs && napi build --platform --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --output-dir native-dist
scripts.build:test-native: node tools/clean-native-output.mjs && napi build --platform --release --features conformance-fixtures --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --output-dir native-dist
scripts.build:examples: npm run build:typescript && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/fixtures/sdk-example-smoke/tsconfig.json
scripts.example:capture: npm run build && npm run build:examples && node .examples-dist/capture-application.js
scripts.examples:check: npm run build && npm run build:examples && node tools/check-examples.mjs
scripts.api:check: npm run build:typescript && api-extractor run && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.browser.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.control.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.demo.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.voice.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.root.json && node tools/check-demo-api-boundary.mjs
scripts.api:update: npm run build:typescript && api-extractor run --local && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.browser.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.control.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.demo.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.voice.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.root.json && node tools/check-demo-api-boundary.mjs
scripts.native:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --all-features
scripts.test:relay: npm run build:test-native && npm run build:typescript && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/.bin/jest src/__tests__/node-relay.test.ts src/__tests__/relay-session.test.ts --runInBand
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test-native && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/.bin/jest && node tests/demo-cli.mjs
